name: gitleaks
description: The pinned secrets scanner of SloppaChoppa's rule LS (RM-a-69): a release binary per OS, its archive's sha256 in lock.json (from the release's gitleaks_<version>_checksums.txt). Installed into <meta root>/state/tools/gitleaks/<lock hash>/<platform>-<arch>/, never in a worktree; nothing under engine/ imports it. Every change here is an owner approval (K20).
